title: Review of c07's wall-tilt-drive negative finding: replicates on fresh seed 5 and fills the a_s 3-5 gap (max 1.8 / 1.8 / 1.5 body lengths at a_s 3 / 4 / 7); Supported
summary: I re-ran the finding's world.py with labkit on new seed 5 at a_s = 3, 4 (between the author's 3 and 5) and 7, T=10000 (rerun/). Max body lengths 1.8, 1.8, 1.5; cells at the end 14, 3, 0 (max 23, 23, 33); persistent splits 17, 8, 1. The a_s=4 sheet shows ringed cells that grow, split by an internal septum and fade out (cells die and are replaced), but no cell translates more than about two body lengths.

observations.M: rerun/a3, a4, a7 FACTS.md: max body lengths 1.8 / 1.8 / 1.5 (below 3) at every setting; a_s=7 goes extinct by t=10000 on seed 5 (the author's seed 1 kept 5 cells)

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed and the same kernel widths (sig_s 8, wall average 3 px); a negative over a 1-parameter family does not exclude other treadmilling forms. a_s=4 shows turnover by septum division and fading cells, which may be worth a look on its own.
